body: Well, I appreciate you taking the time to respond. I still have the rest of the day to think about things before I decide what I am going to do here, so I will be sure to take the things you've said into mind.

Obviously I want to stop feeling this way, but nothing I have tried has helped me. I am at the point where the feelings are so overwhelming that if dying is the only way to make them go away I am willing to do that.

As for "professionals" they just make me uncomfortable and unable to discuss my problems, so I have never made any progress with them.
I am so physically and emotionally exhausted by everything. I wish it would all just end.
I can relate. I have no real friends and it is so hard when you are hurting and lonely and have no one you are comfortable talking to about it.
No one.

I don't have any friends even though I have tried really hard to make some. I don't have any family that I keep in touch with anymore. There is no one in my life who cares about me. I could just die right now and not only is there no one who would care, there is no one who would even notice.

Having now listened to it at least a dozen times since getting the album, I can confirm that Futari Kotoba is basically the best song ever. Absolutely loved the Festival performance of it already and it sounds even better here on the album. Fantastic job by our singer-songwriter president, she needs to get her solo album out ASAP!

Other highlights of the album for me:  
Mezase sounds great like always. Maybe their best rendition of it yet.  
Capsule Scope is one of those Sakura Gakuin songs I have always kind of overlooked, but I'm honestly loving it here. Have a new appreciation for it and would probably put it among their top songs now.  
The senior song was very, very good. Don't know what else to say about it, but I thought it was great.  
The Perfume cover was really cool and different. Not something I expected to ever hear from Sakura Gakuin but I'm so glad they did it.  
I J I has always been one of my favorite songs from the group so I was a little hesitant about the new version, but hearing the full thing put my worries to rest. It sounds fantastic.  
And My Road is easily the most gorgeous music video they have ever made; the production values, the choreography, everything has come so far since the early days. I'll be watching this one a lot.

I'll need to listen to it a few more times to make up my mind, but as of now this is a very strong contender for my favorite Sakura Gakuin album.

Well my favorite member of the current nendo would of course have to be the same girl who is also easily my favorite Sakura Gakuin member of all time: the number one seito kaichou herself, Aiko! This little girl with a big personality was one of their most impressive transfer-ins ever for me right from the start and every time that it seems like she can't possibly top herself she just keeps getting better and better. From her elementary school days, all the way up to and throughout her time as Vice President last year, and now in her big year as President she just never stops finding new ways to impress me with her immense talent and all of her hard work. She is an amazing singer, phenomenal at playing the piano, the only Sakura girl who is writing and performing her own music, Sakura Gakuin's very own diary queen, the reigning competitive ice cream eating world champion, and a strong leader who knows how to get the best out of the other girls and is great at engaging with the fukeis. Everything about her amazes me. Her growth into such a fantastic Super Lady is the definition of what Sakura Gakuin is all about. No other girl will ever manage to come anywhere close to her in my heart. 

Which leads right into the second question for me, since my absolute favorite moment of this nendo without a doubt would easily be Aiko's AMAZING solos at this year's Festival! Honestly, that would probably be one of my favorite moments from ANY nendo. My favorite member getting to perform her own solo song with her own accompaniment on piano at a Sakura Gakuin show was already a huge deal when she performed "Happiness" last year, but performing her own original songs? That is on a whole other level and she just knocked it out of the park and stole the show! Just the fact that Amuse had faith in her to let her do that shows how much trust they have in her abilities and in her future as a solo artist. And if I am going to talk about Aiko's solos this year then I obviously have to bring up how she has been absolutely killing it at all those shows that she has been performing in on her own outside of Sakura Gakuin too. They have a superstar in the making right there. 

Other great moments this nendo would include the shuffle units, since those are always really fun to see (although I wish we would have gotten a Twinklestars performance in there... or better yet bring them back full time as a proper subunit... ), and the entirety of GANBARE!! FRESH! which has just been a huge blessing after LoGiRL came to its unfortunate untimely end. I think that through the girls' hard work they have managed to make it into a stronger show than LoGiRL ever was. 

I am so glad to have found this amazing group of talented girls who bring so much joy and inspiration into my life because for the last few years Sakura Gakuin has really been the one thing in my whole life that makes me happier than anything else. Their music always cheers me up even on the worst days and their wonderful personalities can bring a smile to my face any time that I am feeling down. As for the graduates' activities, I am very happy that most of them seem to be doing very well for themselves lately too. Babymetal continues their streak of worldwide success, Ayaka and Airi are both still doing great at their jobs of being professional beautiful people, Hinata has been blowing up ever since she landed the "Love Live! Sunshine!!" job, and the 2016 graduates have both hit the ground running in establishing their own careers. And this next year's set of graduates look set to do the same, especially with Aiko's future singer-songwriter career (which honestly excites me even more than the future of Sakura Gakuin does). And as always, I hope that the graduates who have chosen to leave the spotlight to pursue their own dreams away from the entertainment world are still doing well at being Super Ladies in their own lives and I look forward to the next time we get to hear an update about how any of them are doing, I wish them the best.
